title: bouteloua humilis
intro: Bouteloua humilis, commonly known as Blue Grama Grass, is a perennial bunchgrass native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and improving digestion. The health benefits of Bouteloua humilis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
